title: The road to Akmentar
intro: Three ways out of Cairo. The first to arrive claims the best sites.

options.label: Across the desert
options.desc: The fastest way, straight across the sand, if you have a guide (without one it takes a day longer). Horses for everyone make it the dearest start. The road splits at an old temple.

options.label: The riverboat
options.desc: The cheapest passage for people and equipment (already paid if you booked with Captain Hamdi). The American expedition has booked the same boat.

options.label: Along the coast
options.desc: The longest way round, but two trucks carry the expedition and the coast road avoids the worst of the desert. Farid or Naguib could save a day on the loading.
